tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every AI model available on JarvisClaw — GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more — with the model IDs you plug straight into the chat tool. Free, and the fastest way to see what you can call.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a chat completion to any model on JarvisClaw through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint — GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more. Pass a specific model ID or use 'auto' for smart routing to the best fit. One tool, every frontier model, no per-provider setup.

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Search the JarvisClaw marketplace for APIs other developers have published — tools, data feeds, and services you can call directly. Filter by category (ai, defi, data, agent) to zero in fast. Great for finding a ready-made capability instead of building it yourself.

tools.name: get_api_detail
tools.description: Get the full spec for a marketplace API by its slug — endpoints, parameters, pricing, and usage examples — everything you need to start calling it. Use this after search_apis to see exactly how a tool works before you wire it in.

tools.name: discover_agents
tools.description: Find other AI agents registered on JarvisClaw and connect to them directly. Search by capability, category, or name to get each agent's MCP URL and API endpoints — so your agent can delegate, collaborate, or chain work with others in the network.

tools.name: aip_resolve
tools.description: Find the best AI provider for a task and get ranked, priced options before you commit a cent. tools.name: aip_list_intents
tools.description: Browse every AI task type AIP can route — chat, image, video, speech, web search, knowledge search — with a short description of each. Call this first to see what's on the menu before you resolve or execute. Free.

tools.name: aip_estimate_cost
tools.description: Preview what a task will cost before committing — get an estimated price for an intent without running it or spending anything. Ideal for budget planning and comparing options up front. Free.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_models, search_apis, discover_agents, aip_execute_with_budget, aip_list_intents · Public sink: chat · Destructive: aip_resolve, aip_execute_with_budget, aip_list_intents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_models, search_apis, discover_agents, aip_execute_with_budget, aip_list_intents · Public sink: chat · Destructive: aip_resolve, aip_execute_with_budget, aip_list_intents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
